compiler_cache: Direct grading reused ccache, never a native library or build directory. Fresh Harbor containers received complete content-checked cache entries only after agent completion and verifier startup. The unchanged test.sh/build backend rebuilt each candidate; source/compiler/include hashes determine cache hits. Cache provenance and native hashes are retained. Final runs are not claimed as cold builds.
limitations: Whole repository including ignored files and .git is captured before grading. Whole root filesystem is not captured; external writes are reviewed from trajectories.
No immutable gateway model revision was recorded. Effective high effort appears in raw Claude session records; launch did not explicitly override effort.
Fallback checks simulate stable platform capability before import and execute real Triton on CUDA; actual ROCm hardware was not tested.
Upstream FP8 Triton reference cannot compile fp8e4nv on sm80. Independent native FP8 checks use PyTorch for 24 combinations.
Native libraries remain on A100 with recorded hashes. Compiler caches were used in curator grading phases; no cold-build claim.
This does not certify isolation against arbitrary native process compromise.
The eight attempts are development evidence across two revisions, not an independent held-out capability/pass-rate estimate. Review does not prove absence of every possible edge case or bypass.
